testimonials.title: What Our Students Say
testimonials.subtitle: Real stories from pastry artists who turned their passion into a career with SARALÖWE Academy.

t1.text: SARALÖWE transformed how I approach cake design. The isomalt module alone is worth every penny — I landed my first luxury wedding contract three weeks after completing it.

t2.text: The video quality and step-by-step guidance are unlike anything I've seen on other platforms. My instructors responded to feedback within hours. Absolutely world-class.

t3.text: I was a complete beginner. Eighteen months later I'm running a boutique cake studio. SARALÖWE gave me the confidence, the skills, and the certificate to make it real.

t4.text: The sugar flower programme is extraordinarily detailed. Every petal, every shade, every tool — explained with the patience of a true master. This is couture education.

pace.title: Learn at Your Pace

certificates.title: Accredited Certificates

mentorship.title: Expert-Led Mentorship

howItWorks.title: From Curious to Couture
howItWorks.subtitle: Four simple steps stand between you and a world-class cake design education.

step1.title: Create Your Account
step1.text: Sign up in under a minute. Choose the plan that suits you and unlock instant access to our full course library.

step2.title: Choose Your Programme
step2.text: Browse disciplines — from sculpted fondant to sugar flowers and isomalt art. Filter by level, duration, or instructor.

step3.title: Learn & Create
step3.text: Follow step-by-step video lessons, download technique sheets, and submit your creations for expert feedback.

step4.title: Earn Your Certificate
step4.text: Complete all modules and assessments to receive your industry-recognised SARALÖWE Academy certificate.

faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before beginning your couture pastry journey.

q1.q: How do I enroll in a course?
q1.a: Simply browse our catalogue, select the programme that speaks to you, and click "Enrol". Free courses are accessible immediately; premium courses are unlocked after checkout.

q2.q: How long do I have access to a course?
q2.a: Once enrolled, your access is lifetime. You can revisit every lesson, download resources, and re-watch masterclasses at any time — on any device.

q3.a: We accept all major credit & debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex), PayPal, and select regional payment methods. All transactions are secured with 256-bit SSL encryption.

q4.q: Will I receive a certificate after completing a course?
q4.a: Yes. Every completed programme earns you a personalised SARALÖWE Certificate of Excellence — printable, shareable, and verified on our platform.

q5.q: Can I learn at my own pace?
q5.a: Absolutely. All content is self-paced with no deadlines. Lessons are bite-sized so you can fit world-class pastry education into any schedule.

q6.q: What can I do with my certificate?
q6.a: Use it to showcase your skills to clients, add it to your portfolio or LinkedIn profile, and position yourself as a trained couture pastry designer.

faq.title: Frequently Asked
faq.q1: What is the difference between Courses and Masterclasses?
faq.a1: Courses are part of our standard curriculum available to all subscribers. Masterclasses are exclusive premium sessions led by world-renowned pastry chefs — available to purchase individually on Monthly, or fully included in the Annual plan.
faq.a2: Yes. You can upgrade or change your plan at any time. Your new plan takes effect immediately and remaining credit is applied.
faq.a3: We do not offer a free tier, but you can browse the course catalog and instructor profiles without a subscription before committing.
faq.a4: We accept all major credit and debit cards via our secure payment gateway.
faq.a5: Yes. You can cancel anytime. Access continues until the end of the current billing period.
faq.q6: How do I use a coupon code?
faq.a6: Coupon codes are only applicable to the Annual plan. When you click Subscribe on the Annual plan, you'll see an optional coupon field in the confirmation screen. Enter your code there to apply the discount before paying.

r20.ladderText: Seven levels, from Apprentice to Elite. Each one asks for certificates, good marks, regular practice, sharing with the community and masterclasses. Open your badge to see exactly what your next level needs.
r20.keepText: You keep the badge you already had. The new, harder rules only decide your next level-ups.
r20.eliteText: The top badge is now approved personally by Chef Sara: your signature showpiece, on top of two years of excellence.
r20.certText: A certificate is earned by passing the course assignment (70% or more), after finishing every lesson and quiz. A first mark that fails allows one resubmission.
r20.topbarText: The top bar now has Home, Masterclasses, Ebooks and Academy. On phones, tap the house icon. Search is a small icon that opens when you point at it or tap it.
r20.adminTitle: Manage Users: badges with their numbers
r20.adminText: Each student shows their badge, certificates, quiz and assignment averages and days as a member. From Master Chef, an "Approve Elite showpiece" button appears.

r21.name: The Winter Update
r21.challengeText: Bake one tier, photograph it on white and let the whole academy vote. Entries until 25 December, voting 26 December to 1 January, winners on 5 January. Every cake has its own page to share.
r21.expText: A cinematic experience for large screens, or a touch-first one for your phone with a bottom tab bar. Each device keeps its own; change it any time in Settings.
r21.homeText: The home page now opens with a hand-drawn world that grows before your eyes, then reveals the academy.
r21.playerText: Burgundy and gold, a perfectly centred play button that comes back on pause, larger controls and smoother playback.
r21.buyText: No more cart: “Buy now” takes you straight to a secure checkout with that course.
r21.xmasText: A real garland of lights, gentle snow and festive touches, until 7 January.
r21.lookText: New blush glass top bar with our lions crest. The light/dark switch is gone: SARALÖWE now has one art-directed look everywhere.
r21.fastText: Lighter pages and quicker loading, especially on phones.
r21.adminText: Admin › Cake Challenge: approve cakes, follow live scores, check voters, and send the announcement emails (preview and test first).

r1.title: Theme
items: Theme: New Year / end-of-year celebration 2026–2027.
The design must represent the New Year celebration.
You have complete creative freedom in interpreting the theme.

r2.title: Cake requirements
items: Only ONE-TIER cakes are accepted. No two-tier or multi-tier cakes.
Both real edible cakes and dummy cakes are allowed.
No restrictions on size, height or shape.
All cake design techniques are allowed: fondant, buttercream, ganache, modelling, airbrush, painting, sculpting, etc.
Decorations must be created and assembled by the participating student.

r3.title: Photography
items: Upload 3 to 5 photographs of your final creation.
The background must be completely white.
The table or surface under the cake must also be completely white.
The cake must be clearly visible, with at least one full front-view photograph.
Close-up photographs of details are encouraged.
No collages, distracting decorations, filters that alter the cake, or watermarks.

r4.title: Authenticity & AI policy
items: AI-generated cakes are strictly forbidden.
AI-generated or digitally fabricated decorations in submitted photographs are not accepted.
You must confirm: “I certify that this cake was created and decorated by me.”
Using another person's work or photographs means immediate disqualification.
The academy may ask for more photographs or a short making-of video to verify authenticity.

r5.title: Participation
items: Open to SARALÖWE Academy members with a confirmed email address.
Participation is free.
One submission per student.
Register for the challenge before submitting.
You can edit your submission until the deadline.
Late submissions are not accepted.

r6.title: Dates
items: Submission deadline: 25 December 2026 at 23:59.
Voting: 26 December 2026 to 1 January 2027.
Results: 5 January 2027.
All deadlines follow Morocco local time.

r7.title: Voting
items: Voting takes place directly on the SARALÖWE Academy platform, with a live ranking.
Any account with a confirmed email can vote, including accounts created during the challenge.
Each account can vote only once for the same cake, and can vote for several cakes.
Student vote = 1 point. Instructor vote = 10 points. Administrator vote = 10 points.
A staff member's vote is never counted twice.
A cake needs votes from at least three different accounts to be eligible to win.
Fake accounts, automated voting, vote manipulation and buying votes are prohibited; such votes are removed.
You cannot vote for your own creation.

r8.title: Winners & fairness
items: Winners are decided by the total weighted score.
In case of a tie, the academy jury decides on creativity, technical execution and interpretation of the theme.
All submissions need administrator approval.
SARALÖWE Academy may disqualify entries that break the rules.
Winners receive official recognition and rewards announced by the academy.

r9.title: Publication & permissions
items: Approved creations may be shown in the challenge gallery with the student's display name.
You agree to the publication of your submitted photographs within the academy.
Any promotional use outside the platform requires your permission.

faq.title: Good to know
faq.q1: Can I enter a cake I already made?
faq.a1: Yes, if it fits the New Year theme, it is one single tier and you made and decorated it yourself. Photograph it on a completely white background.
faq.a2: Anyone with a free SARALÖWE account and a confirmed email, including friends and family you invite. Each account votes once per cake and can vote for several cakes.
faq.q3: Why do instructor votes count 10 points?
faq.a3: Their eye is professional. Students count 1 point; instructors and admins count 10. Nobody's vote is ever counted twice.
faq.q4: When will my cake appear in the gallery?
faq.a4: After the academy approves it, usually within a day. If something needs to change, you get a note and can update your entry until 25 December.
faq.a5: Yes, until 25 December at 23:59. Each change is checked again before it appears.
faq.a6: By total points at the end of voting, among cakes voted by at least three different accounts. In a tie, the academy jury decides on creativity, technique and theme.
